\begin{example} \end{example}[Minkowski space]

Source: petersen:page-0025 ↗ def:pet-ch1-pseudo-riemannian

1. ch1:1.1.6For $n=n_1+n_2$ and $\mathbb {R}^{n_1,n_2}=\mathbb {R}^{n_1}\times \mathbb {R}^{n_2}$, define \[ g((p,v),(p,w))=v_1\cdot w_1-v_2\cdot w_2. \] This metric has index $n_2$. The cases $n_1=1$ or $n_2=1$ are the usual sign conventions for Minkowski space. \end{example}
